# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(mgcv)
library(janitor)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38)
library(DMRcate)
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
m_values <- readRDS(here("cache/rwh_m_values.rds"))
all_m_values <- readRDS(here("data/GSE223817_m.rds"))
```

```{r}
cols <- c("UCSC_RefGene_Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Group", "Regulatory_Feature_Name", "Regulatory_Feature_Group")
probe_info <- IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Other[, cols] %>% clean_names()
probe_info <- data.frame(probe_info)
```

```{r}
cols <- c("EPICv1_Loci", "UCSC_RefGene_Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Group", "GencodeV41_Name", "Regulatory_Feature_Group")
probe_info_v2 <- IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Other[, cols] %>% clean_names()
colnames(probe_info_v2)[1] <- "probe_id"
probe_info_v2 <- data.frame(probe_info_v2)
```

```{r}
# Wrangle ucsc_ref_gene_group in probe_info
# Where multiple groups, use the most common one
most_common <- function(x) {
  # Get most common item in vector. If tie, get random most common item.
  tab <- table(x)
  tab <- tab[tab == max(tab)]
  return(names(tab)[sample(length(tab), size=1)])
}

probe_info$region <- probe_info$ucsc_ref_gene_group %>% 
  str_split(";") %>%
  sapply(most_common)

probe_info_v2$region <- probe_info_v2$ucsc_ref_gene_group %>% 
  str_split(";") %>%
  sapply(most_common)
```


```{r}
stopifnot(rownames(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations) == rownames(probe_info))
probe_info <- cbind(probe_info, IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(rownames(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations) == rownames(probe_info_v2))
probe_info_v2 <- cbind(probe_info_v2, IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(rownames(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Islands.UCSC) == rownames(probe_info))
probe_info$island <- IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Islands.UCSC$Relation_to_Island
```

```{r}
stopifnot(rownames(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Islands.UCSC) == rownames(probe_info_v2))
probe_info_v2$island <- IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Islands.UCSC$Relation_to_Island
```

```{r}
probe_gene_overlaps <- countOverlaps(
  GRanges(seqnames=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations$chr,
               ranges=IRanges(start=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations$pos,
                              end=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations$pos+1)),
  transcripts(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
)
probe_info$gene_overlaps <- probe_gene_overlaps
```

```{r}
probe_gene_overlaps <- countOverlaps(
  GRanges(seqnames=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations$chr,
               ranges=IRanges(start=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations$pos,
                              end=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations$pos+1)),
  transcripts(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
)
probe_info_v2$gene_overlaps <- probe_gene_overlaps
```

```{r}
probe_exon_overlaps <- countOverlaps(
  GRanges(seqnames=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations$chr,
               ranges=IRanges(start=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations$pos,
                              end=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19::Locations$pos+1)),
  exons(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
)
probe_info$exon_overlaps <- probe_exon_overlaps
```

```{r}
probe_exon_overlaps <- countOverlaps(
  GRanges(seqnames=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations$chr,
               ranges=IRanges(start=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations$pos,
                              end=IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations$pos+1)),
  exons(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
)
probe_info_v2$exon_overlaps <- probe_exon_overlaps
```

```{r}
probe_info$intronic <- probe_info$exon_overlaps == 0 & probe_info$region == "Body"
probe_info$intergenic <- probe_info$ucsc_ref_gene_name == ""

table(probe_info$intronic, probe_info$intergenic)
table(probe_info$intronic, probe_info$region)
table(probe_info$intergenic, probe_info$region)
```

```{r}
probe_info <- probe_info %>%
  dplyr::rename(original_region="region") %>%
  mutate(region=case_when(
           intronic ~ "Intronic",
           intergenic ~ "Intergenic",
           TRUE ~ original_region
         ))
```



```{r}
probe_info_v2$intergenic <- probe_info_v2$gene_overlaps == 0 & probe_info_v2$ucsc_ref_gene_name == ""
probe_info_v2 <- probe_info_v2 %>% mutate(region=case_when(
  intergenic ~ "intergenic",
  region == "" ~ "intronic",
  TRUE ~ region
))
```

```{r}
probe_info_v2 %>% mutate(region=ifelse(str_detect(region, "exon_") & region != "exon_1", "exon_2+", region)) %>%
  with(table(region))
probe_info_v2 %>% mutate(region=ifelse(str_detect(region, "exon_") & region != "exon_1", "exon_2+", region)) %>%
  with(table(region, island))
```

```{r}
probe_info_v2 <- probe_info_v2 %>%
  mutate(region=ifelse(str_detect(region, "exon_") & region != "exon_1", "exon_2+", region))

# probe_info_v2 %>% filter(region == "intronic")
```


```{r}
table(probe_info$region)
table(probe_info_v2$region)
```

```{r}
probe_info %>% group_by(region) %>% summarise(n=n(), mean=n()/nrow(.))
```

```{r}
probe_info_v2 %>% group_by(region) %>% summarise(n=n(), mean=n()/nrow(.))
```


# Filtering

```{r}
dim(m_values)
dim(all_m_values)
```


```{r}
table(rownames(m_values) %in% rownames(probe_info))
table(rownames(m_values) %in% probe_info_v2$probe_id)
```

```{r}
m <- match(rownames(m_values), rownames(probe_info))
table(is.na(m))
```


```{r}
filtered_probe_info <- probe_info[m,]
filtered_probe_info$probe_id <- rownames(filtered_probe_info)
filtered_probe_info <- filtered_probe_info %>% select(probe_id, everything())
dim(filtered_probe_info)
```


```{r}
saveRDS(filtered_probe_info, here("cache/filtered_probe_info_epic_v1.rds"))
```



```{r}
m_values <- m_values[rownames(m_values) %in% probe_info_v2$probe_id,]
dim(m_values)
```

```{r}
m <- match(rownames(m_values), probe_info_v2$probe_id)
table(is.na(m))
```

```{r}
filtered_probe_info_v2 <- probe_info_v2[m,]
dim(filtered_probe_info_v2)
```


```{r}
saveRDS(filtered_probe_info_v2, here("cache/filtered_probe_info_epic_v2.rds"))
```
